content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Roanoke

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and professional history to ensure you meet the foundation needed to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world scenarios, and exam strategy—delivered entirely online at times that fit your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp coursework, submit your official PMI application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI to activate your eligibility and reserve your exam seat within the required window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor guidance to consolidate your knowledge. Schedule your PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center and take the computer-based assessment on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Document your continuing education through PMI-approved activities and submit your renewal before expiration to sustain your credential and professional standing.
